rust_summary: server-only online-player item cooldown setters and exact remaining/total tick queries in `native_cooldowns.rs`.
doc_summary: server cooldown helpers: `set_item_cooldown(player, target, ticks) -> Result<bool, String>` starts or replaces for positive ticks and removes/sends duration zero for zero ticks; negative durations and reentrant setters are errors. `item_cooldown_remaining(player, target) -> Option<(i32, i32)>` returns exact remaining and total whole ticks. `NativeCooldownTarget::ItemId`, `Stack` and `Group` resolve the item's default group, the stack's effective group and an explicit group respectively. The current actor is checked first, then online placed guests while their LAN host is available; unavailable players, invalid items and client execution refuse the operation. Only the affected player receives the cooldown packet, including the integrated owner. Positive item/stack starts retain the existing cancellable item cooldown hook; removals and explicit groups do not call it. No optional group event is added. Bundles need the @API:item_cooldown_helpers@ hook requirement.
